chunks.title: GE Vernova (GE Vernova) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: GE Vernova is a Strategic Corporate / COP31 Supporter headquartered in United States. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Official COP31 Climate Supporter showcasing grid modernization, wind & electrification technologies. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: COP31 Climate Supporter & clean-power/grid technology deployment partner. Source verification: https://cop31.tr/partners/climate-supporters.

chunks.title: GE Vernova Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: GE Vernova provides the following climate financing instruments: Strategic Corporate Partnership, Corporate Venture / Co-Development. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 0 to USD 50,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Large Corporate, Project SPV, Climate-Tech Startup.

chunks.title: GE Vernova Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by GE Vernova: Electrification & Grid, Renewable Energy, Energy Storage, Climate-Tech Innovation. Target geographic focus includes: Global, Türkiye, Europe, Americas. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: GE Vernova Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete GE Vernova's application form: Treat as Strategic Corporate Partner / COP31 Supporter (not confirmed investor); Share Level 1 PUBLIC overview only prior to mutual NDA. Explicit exclusion rules: Misrepresenting COP31 Supporter status as open grant funding. Official application portal: https://cop31.tr/partners/climate-supporters.

chunks.title: GE Vernova Form Template: Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form
chunks.text: GE Vernova uses the 'Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form' workflow governed by GFANZ Catalytic Capital Repository / Impact Management Project (IMP) / IRIS+ Climate Metrics. Typical review timeline is 4–10 weeks (Pitch Screening -> Commercial & Climate DD -> IC Approval). Form sections required: 1. Venture / Asset Overview, 2. Investment Thesis, 3. Product & Execution, 4. Impact & Risk, 5. Executive Pitch.
